review.description: Existing live/retained task views still poll the same journal and retain drafts through view closure. Admin operations have their own cached settings pane; automatic reviews appear as ordinary retained runs already covered by the existing work projection. No task status is inferred from transcript prose.
review.implementation: Inspected unchanged read_snapshot/read_run/transcript paths and new separate read_plugin_admin responses. The admin document still has no Inbox/Agents task navigation, and no direct iframe localhost request or owner credential was added. Role-default selection belongs to the launch contract, not a new task page.
review.tests: Existing assembled MCP launch/question/follow-up, work-status, reconnect and independent settings/draft browser assertions remain mapped and passed among 74 cases. New cached operation reads do not claim host callbacks, full runtime availability or manual accessibility. Existing live/soak gaps remain open.
